_comment: Which starter model pack replaces which stock wrestler. kit.py writes these into aki.json (components.models.slots)
and writes models/roster.json from them. Ids are the game's own wrestler ids (the aki_modelimport mod's 'Log
wrestler ids' option prints them). Labels are neutral on purpose: the kit names no real wrestlers.
The first six are the wrestlers of the kit's tag team attract demo in Raw (found with 'Log wrestler ids',
2026-11-08); the last two are their neighbours in the id table. No costume = every costume of that wrestler.
